subject: Temporary trial freeze request during procurement validation
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Sara Chen <sara.chen@clarityaihealth.com>, Tom Perez <tom.perez@clarityaihealth.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary trial freeze request during procurement validation

Hi Sara / Tom,

Quick update from our side: our finance team has finished the quote and I sent the PO draft back to you this morning (attached). I heard from your procurement contact that they need to run one additional vendor verification step which will likely push formal PO approval to next week (targeting 5/17).

To avoid ClarityAI losing the evaluation momentum while procurement finishes up, would Redwood be able to pause the trial countdown or grant a short hold on the sandbox for ~10 days? The customer team is actively evaluating latency and memory behavior on a 5k token workflow and losing access would interrupt the quantitative tests.

If helpful we can:
- Pause the trial timer for 10 calendar days (preferred)
- Or add a token credit top-up that covers current test volume for 7 days

I've attached the PO draft for reference (PO_draft_ClarityAI.pdf). Monica, looping you in to assess whether a pause is ok from a billing/finance perspective. Aisha, can you confirm operationally how we would implement a pause so their tests keep running?

Goal: preserve the evaluation state so the team can finish the benchmark run without rebaselining once the PO clears.

Thanks — please reply with what works and I will share next steps with procurement.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
(415) 555-0126

From: Sara Chen <sara.chen@clarityaihealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Perez <tom.perez@clarityaihealth.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary trial freeze request during procurement validation

Thanks Logan — appreciate the heads up and the PO draft.

On Sun, May 10, 2026 at 9:17 AM Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick update from our side: our finance team has finished the quote and I sent the PO draft back to you this morning (attached). I heard from your procurement contact that they need to run one additional vendor verification step which will likely push formal PO approval to next week (targeting 5/17).

We can confirm procurement is doing an extra security/third-party validation that should complete around 17-May. That said, the engineering team needs uninterrupted access to finish the 5k token throughput runs — losing state will force a re-run and put us behind schedule.

A 10-day hold would be ideal for us. Alternatively, if you can provide a short token grant for the next 7 days that would also work as a fallback. Two quick questions:
1) If you pause the trial timer, does it preserve existing KV caches/instances or is state cleared when the sandbox is reactivated?
2) If you issue token credits, will they be tied to the same project and visible in our usage dashboard?

If you can confirm either option today we can tell procurement to expect the PO next Monday.

Sara Chen
Head of Engineering | ClarityAI Health
Sara.Chen@clarityaihealth.com

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Sara Chen <sara.chen@clarityaihealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary trial freeze request during procurement validation

Hi Sara — thanks for the quick reply and great questions.

On Sun, May 10, 2026 at 11:02 AM Sara Chen <sara.chen@clarityaihealth.com> wrote:
> A 10-day hold would be ideal for us. Alternatively, if you can provide a short token grant for the next 7 days that would also work as a fallback. Two quick questions:
> 1) If you pause the trial timer, does it preserve existing KV caches/instances or is state cleared when the sandbox is reactivated?
> 2) If you issue token credits, will they be tied to the same project and visible in our usage dashboard?

Short answers:
1) Pause behavior — we can freeze the trial timer without deleting project state. The sandbox instances will be reserved and KV cache snapshots will be kept for the pause duration (we will not evict unless you ask us to).
2) Credits — any token credit we apply will be scoped to your existing project and will appear in the usage dashboard under the same project id; you can monitor consumption in real time.

Operationally I recommend the pause for 10 calendar days to preserve the full environment and avoid any reconfiguration work on your side. If finance needs that as an ask, Monica can confirm approval to pause without crediting spend.

Monica — can you confirm whether finance is comfortable with a 10-day timer pause tied to DEAL-2026-1147? If yes I'll instruct the platform team to implement the freeze at 23:59 UTC tonight so the customer keeps the current session and caches intact.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.com

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Sara Chen <sara.chen@clarityaihealth.com>, Tom Perez <tom.perez@clarityaihealth.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary trial freeze request during procurement validation

Sara / Tom — good news: Monica confirmed finance is OK with a 10-day pause for DEAL-2026-1147. We will schedule the freeze for 2026-05-10 23:59:00 UTC to preserve your current environment and KV caches. No credits are required for this hold.

Action items:
- Redwood: pause trial timer at 2026-05-10 23:59:00 UTC, preserve caches and project state (Aisha to confirm when done).
- ClarityAI: procurement to return signed PO via DocuSign link once ready (see related link).
- Logan: will update the HubSpot deal record (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1147) and attach the PO draft you provided.

Sara — I will follow up when the platform confirms the freeze has been applied. Happy to extend further if procurement slips past the 10-day window.

Best,
